title: Good: VerifiedPayload newtype enforces trust boundary at compile time
description:
**File:** rust/lichen-link/src/link_layer.rs
**Lines:** 21-82

**What's good:** The VerifiedPayload newtype pattern enforces the trust boundary between link-layer authentication and upper-layer processing at compile time. The type can only be constructed via pub(crate) new() after verification passes, ensuring callers cannot accidentally process unauthenticated data.

This is worth defending against 'simplification' suggestions to just return Vec<u8> - the type system enforcement is valuable for security-critical boundaries.
